name: Gray Neil Burkeworth
original_name: グレイ＝ニール＝バークワース
source:
"I'm the representative of the Burkeworth Company, Gray Neil Burkeworth."

The second head of the Burkeworth Company that is a member of the Merchants Guild.
A skilled merchant and influential man who has invested in the navy and various other guilds around town.
